title: 24 Speculative Decoding and VTG Candidate Scheduling
summary: Defines the micro-speculation architecture for speculative decoding on constrained GNUS nodes: drafter backend classes, confidence-scheduled verification, VTG hot shards, and signed swarm outcome events.
notes: SPEC vs DOC ambiguity resolved toward SPEC per precedence rule: architecture chapter mixes rationale prose (DOC lean) with normative technical contracts. SPEC signals dominate — node capability advertisement JSON schema consumed by the Router, signed (ed25519) swarm outcome event schema with required fields, backend-selection ordering, role-specific speculation policy table, operating budgets and branch/depth limits, phased implementation plan. No ADR hallmarks (no Status field, no Decision/Consequences sections); no user-story language. Filename hash is a deterministic fallback (hex of first four slug chars) because no code-execution tool was available to compute SHA-256; slug itself is unique so no sibling collision.
